title: Allow *.internal wildcard TLS certificate
body:
### Problem

.internal is officially revered by [ICANN](https://www.icann.org/en/board-activities-and-meetings/materials/approved-resolutions-special-meeting-of-the-icann-board-29-07-2024-en#section2.a) and [IETF](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/draft-davies-internal-tld/) for private use. Please consider allow *.internal wildcard TLS certificates.
